☁︎ Minecraft worlds

From fortified castles and village gates to portals and giant fantasy sculptures, I enjoy creating builds that give a server its own identity.

✦ Gaming visuals

I also experiment with stream thumbnails and gaming artwork, with bold focal points, colour and energetic compositions.

☁︎ Random notes about my work

  • I like builds you can recognise from across the map. If a landmark needs a sign to explain it, I keep going.
  • Thumbnails get one big focal point and one loud title, then I add glow until it feels right.
  • Mist, blossoms and castles keep sneaking into everything I make.
  • I make Minecraft thumbnails and builds for servers like Sigma SMP.
  • I also make live thumbnails for Valorant, Genshin Impact and Wuthering Waves streams.
  • Between projects I share giveaways and clips on my socials.
